name: PREVIOUSLY IN GTM
tagline: A weekly read for founders, GTM leaders and growth marketers.
title: Rent your channels. Own the list that travels between them
standfirst: A long read on what changed in startup go to market over the last year, and the one column in your plan that nobody on your team owns.
cover_sub: The one column in your go to market plan that nobody on your team owns.

insight.label: By the numbers
insight.text: Meta's share of PLG ad budgets between last November and August, as B2B teams moved money between channels.
insight.source: Source: Growth Unhinged (Kyle Poyar), citing Primer benchmarks of 379 B2B advertisers. Reported, not audited.

quote.label: Worth pinning above your desk
quote.text: As narrow and as short as possible.
quote.attribution: Jorge B. Macías, on the account list, via GTM Engineer Pulse #48

framework.title: Four questions before a channel gets budget
framework.subtitle: Ask them of the list, not the platform.
framework.footer: The exit question is the author's own test.

items.name: List
items.question: Who exactly are you reaching?
items.example: One scored list, short enough to name in a meeting.

items.name: Owner
items.question: Who keeps it honest?
items.example: One person who can say no to a channel.

items.name: Signal
items.question: What do you send back?
items.example: The lowest funnel event with enough weekly volume.

items.name: Exit
items.question: How fast can you move?
items.example: Working days to shift a third of paid spend.
